commitMessage: jarvise: P3 historical Yahoo FETCH_ONCE authority and pre-fetch build preparation (no network)

cohortSelfExclusion.reason: The consumption record cannot hash its own final bytes; its identity is bound by the authority and manifest instead.

cohort.reason: C: pins the ratified OD-P3-1 window 2018-01-02 through 2026-09-04 with cutoff close 2026-09-04T20:00:00.000Z; runtime wall-clock derivation is declared FORBIDDEN and the 81 calendar sessions after the cutoff are explicitly excluded.

D: pins the 802-identity cohort by registryManifestId sha256:cdcb86d1, authorityPolicyId sha256:a83a34cb and namespacePolicyId sha256:747e1108; enumeration is from the authoritative CAS registry manifest and runtime symbol enumeration is FORBIDDEN.

F: closes the corporateActionPolicyHash gap with a real canonicalHash over the frozen CORPORATE_ACTION_POLICY.SPLIT_ADJUSTED policy, the policy module bytes and the ratified source declaration; no placeholder.
G: closes the transformImplementationHash gap with a real TransformImplementationManifest/1 over the five module bytes that define the raw to CanonicalDailyBars/1 transform; no placeholder.
E: deterministic acquisitionRequestIdentity and acquisitionKey derivation, CAS cohort enumeration, and recomputation of both snapshot-core hashes. Reads no clock and constructs no HTTP client.

H: OD-P3-3 CANONICAL_PROVIDER_RESULT_BYTES serialization plus the pinned-raw to CanonicalDailyBars/1 normalizer; rebinds every timestamp to the pinned canonical session close so half-days are correct.
I: bounded acquirer enforcing OD-P3-4 (3 attempts per EMPTY key, 2406 invocation ceiling, retry only on TIMEOUT/429/5xx). Imports no provider library at module scope.

J: the prepared execution authority published as PREPARED_NOT_EXECUTABLE with executionAuthorized and networkAuthorized false; it declares future bounds and grants no network. The P2 authority is referenced, never mutated.
K: the single governed execution entry point. Terminates at VERSION_CACHED, never acquires a non-EMPTY key, and fail-closes without an Owner activation document.
T: window determinism, 2183 sessions, exact 802 cohort, key determinism and sensitivity, both non-placeholder hashes, identity boundary, no vintage claim, no regime emission.
T: canonical serialization determinism, half-day pinned timestamps, split/dividend carriage, and fail-closed behaviour for empty, malformed, duplicate, out-of-window and non-calendar results.
T: prepared-not-executable authority, activation byte binding, 3-attempt bound, 4th attempt refusal, 2406 ceiling, retry taxonomy, and no refetch after RAW_PINNED.
